rationale: desktopCapturer.getSources fails to return sources when Windows thumbnails are requested, with a WGC start-capture error and a zero-thumbnail workaround. desktopcapturer is the direct component. The multiline call depends on undefined data.options and no runnable app is supplied, so request a Fiddle. The named Razer window is a capture target, not proof the bug belongs to that app. Earlier appIcon data URL failure on macOS and parented-window omissions differ in symptom and platform.
